result:
Round 176 is done on my side and waiting for C's browser check. Nothing was committed or pushed, and I did not run the browser rows; those are C's.

**What changed** (only the 9 granted files plus the 2 new ones; protected files have no diff against `c53eefc`):
- **Mute on** for track, group and Master is now a filled grey: `border-muted bg-muted text-background`, with the same fill on hover and press.
- **Solo on** for track and group is now a filled light: `border-foreground bg-foreground text-background`, also with no hover or press step.
- **Group Solo mixed** now uses a light half: `border-foreground … from-foreground/40 …`.
- **The Clip-details separator** now hovers `hover:bg-foreground/50`, which fixes C's finding A-R175-DETAIL-SEP-ACCENT.
- **Tests:** four existing test files have the expected tokens updated (L1–L4). The new `mixer-onstate-colour-ui.test.tsx` adds DXM1–DXM6, which mount the real workspace and toggle state with real clicks.
- **Docs:** doc 144 is updated as specified, and the new Georgian doc 145 is in place.

**Tests run:**
- Base tests before the edits: 184/184.
- The 14 targeted files after the edits: 190/190.
- `npm run typecheck` passes, and `npm run lint` shows 0 errors (218 older warnings, none in my files).
- The Biome check on the owned code and test files is clean.
- All 8 mutations (m258–m265) turned the required tests red. Each file was restored and its sha checked.
- The full suite, `npm run verify`, the build and e2e were not run; they belong to the root gate.

**One finding for B (A-R176-MIXED-REST-BASE):** B's §0.1 contrast figures for the mixed Solo assume a faint base fill under the half-fill. In fact tailwind-merge v3 removes that fill, and an existing test (UM11) already checks it is gone.
- At rest, the half against the group header is **3.30**, not 3.62. That still passes the 3:1 threshold and sits exactly on B's 3.3 floor.
- The letter on the half is 4.22 at rest, 3.66 on hover and 3.42 on press.
- On the mixed button the background deliberately steps up on hover and press, so "hover and press equal rest" only applies to the plain Mute and Solo buttons. I wrote this into C's CC-ONSTATE check so it isn't read as a failure.
- I changed no tokens for this; B should decide.

**Code review** (code-reviewer subagent): 9/10, nothing blocking.
- I fixed the three gaps it found in doc 145.
- I did not adopt its suggestion to assert the base fill is still there, because that fill is actually removed.
- I kept the `as const` in DXM6, which follows an existing use in another test. B can rule on it.
- Its Architecture note is copied word for word into the report for B: the mixer strings keep changing and each change forces updates in 4–5 test files (tracked under GATE167-TOKEN-TEST-FRAGILITY), and the new test repeats the fake audio harness (already queued as ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS).

DUX-R-5 as a whole is not finished: stages 5b-2b and 5b-3 remain, and I have not marked anything in the backlog.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `a-round-176.md`
- `a-round-176/` (`vitest-files.txt`, `end-sha256.txt`, `diff-vs-start.patch`, `mutations/`, `out/`, `tools/`)
